notes: The Blender source bundle contains a high-quality unrigged realistic male base and anatomy references, but no deform armature or animation skeleton.
The established Humanoid Rig v1 remains the compatibility skeleton because it has the project's complete 66-bone hierarchy and human_idle clip; the original female/neutral runtime asset is unchanged.
The male mesh is normalized to 1.75 m, bound with Blender automatic weights, limited to four normalized influences per vertex, and given direct palm influences on the canonical hand bones.

The shirt is an independently skinned shell with measured 4–14 mm body clearance, a measured U-shaped collar cut, and adaptive 3–10 mm physical thickness inward; it preserves at least 1 mm between its inner surface and skin. Trousers retain the user-reviewed 14 mm fit across 768 body-surface samples and add 10 mm thickness inward to preserve the outer silhouette. Both garments read the shared project fit-profile JSON rather than using builder-only clearance constants.

The reference shirt and body meshes were measured directly in Blender. The downloaded Quaternius male preview was also inspected, but its body and outfit are a single mesh and provide no separate clothing-clearance data.
Model appearance is a prototype for director/playtest review; NPC body-type selection is not changed by this asset-only task.
anchor_vaginal is intentionally not present on this male-presenting model; semantic anchors are presentation locators, not simulation state.
The Blender male body is CC0. The inherited rig and animation source license remains unknown, so the assembled GLB is not approved for a public or commercial build.
